title: Scale strip
description: A scheme's key scale in the light theme, steps 50 to 950, as built. Drawn by the ScaleStrip composite on Primitives › Color › How the scale is built.

hue.description: The hue of the key scale, such as pink or blue.

key.description: The key step: the key color sits exact here.

step.description: The step of the scale, 50 to 950.

primitive.description: The primitive of the step, without its color. prefix, such as pink.light.600.

hex.description: The color as built, in uppercase hex.
